name: night falls and the fires light their rooms

steps.note: two rooms joined by a doorway, a pillar in each, three fires and a computer nobody is using

steps.shot: eight in the morning: daylight, so the canvas is drawn as it was

steps.note: 1920 ticks a world hour: fifteen hours on is eleven at night

steps.shot: eleven at night: the fires light their rooms, and the walls cast shadows
close up: the light is smooth across texels, and every texel is one colour
